checks.label: ESG 與年報期間一致
checks.rule_quote: regarding the same period covered in its annual report
checks.criteria: 核對 ESG 與年報的起訖日；未提供年報時列待補，不能以ESG自述證明兩份相同。

checks.label: 年度發布及兩個網站刊載
checks.rule_quote: must be published on the Exchange’s website and the issuer’s website
checks.criteria: 需正式刊載日期及交易所、公司網站網址；待刊稿尚未發布不等於已違規。

checks.label: 向股東提供獨立 ESG 報告
checks.rule_quote: provide the ESG report to its shareholders using electronic means
checks.criteria: 獨立報告的股東提供安排及適用法律須另核；PDF內容不能證明已送達。

checks.label: 獨立 ESG 與年報同時發布
checks.rule_quote: at the same time as the publication of the annual report
checks.criteria: 核對正式刊載日期；待刊稿列待補發布安排，不判違規。

checks.label: 額外重大議題及持份者意見
checks.rule_quote: additional ESG issues and KPIs that reflect the issuer’s significant environmental and social impacts
checks.criteria: 此項屬鼓勵性披露；如有額外重大議題，記錄選擇及持份者意見，不能當硬性遺漏。

checks.label: 獨立鑒證的級別、範圍及程序
checks.rule_quote: Where independent assurance is obtained
checks.criteria: 只在取得鑒證時核對級別、範圍及程序；沒有鑒證並非違規，未說明有無則適用性待確認。

checks.label: 重大議題與氣候財務影響
checks.rule_quote: could reasonably be expected to affect its cash flows, its access to finance or cost of capital
checks.criteria: 重大議題辨識及氣候財務重大性，不能把所有一般環保活動當作財務重大風險。

checks.label: 量化數據、目的及比較資料
checks.rule_quote: Quantitative information should be accompanied by a narrative
checks.criteria: 歷史KPI可量度、有目的及影響解釋，適當時有比較資料；不把方向性目標一律當缺少數值。

checks.label: 平衡呈現
checks.rule_quote: avoid selections, omissions, or presentation formats
checks.criteria: 只報告有具體原文支持的偏頗或誤導呈現；僅有平衡聲明不能核實全體資訊，欠原始資料時列需人工核實。

checks.label: 跨年方法一致性
checks.rule_quote: consistent methodologies to allow for meaningful comparisons
checks.criteria: 方法及KPI變更是否交代；不得假設沿用方法或直接將數字相同視為口徑相同。

checks.label: 董事報告的環境政策及表現
checks.rule_quote: a discussion of the issuer’s environmental (including climate-related) policies and performance
checks.criteria: 核對年報董事報告的業務回顧及ESG銜接。

checks.label: 董事報告的重大法律合規
checks.rule_quote: a discussion of the issuer’s compliance with the relevant laws and regulations
checks.criteria: 核對對公司有重大影響的法規遵守說明；不以一般聲明核實實際法律合規。

checks.label: 董事報告的關鍵關係
checks.rule_quote: an account of the issuer’s key relationships
checks.criteria: 核對員工、客戶、供應商及其他關鍵關係。

checks.label: 董事會監督 ESG
checks.rule_quote: a disclosure of the board’s oversight of ESG issues
checks.criteria: 需董事會聲明及監督角色，只有工作小組介紹不足。

checks.label: ESG 管理策略及重大議題管理
checks.rule_quote: the board’s ESG management approach and strategy
checks.criteria: 辨識、評估、排序及管理重大ESG議題和業務風險的程序。

checks.label: 董事會檢討目標進度
checks.rule_quote: how the board reviews progress made against ESG-related goals and targets
checks.criteria: 董事會如何檢討進度，以及目標與業務的關係。

checks.label: 重大議題辨識及選擇準則
checks.rule_quote: the process to identify and the criteria for the selection of material ESG factors
checks.criteria: 辨識程序及選擇準則兩者均須檢視。

checks.label: 持份者參與程序及結果
checks.rule_quote: a description of significant stakeholders identified
checks.criteria: 如有持份者參與，須有主要持份者、程序及結果；未進行不可猜測。

checks.label: 排放及能源計算依據
checks.rule_quote: Information on the standards, methodologies, assumptions and/
checks.criteria: 標準、方法、假設／工具、換算因子來源；只列因子不能確認其他要素。

checks.label: 影響可比性的變更
checks.rule_quote: any changes to the methods or KPIs used
checks.criteria: 方法、KPI及其他影響比較的變動；欠底稿不能核實數值真實性。

checks.label: 報告邊界及選取程序
checks.rule_quote: describing the process used to identify which entities or operations are included
checks.criteria: 需有涵蓋公司／營運及選取程序；財務合併邊界不必然等同ESG營運邊界。

checks.label: 範圍變更及原因
checks.rule_quote: explain the difference and reason for the change
checks.criteria: 如有範圍變動，核對差異及原因，不把正常擴展業務直接判錯。

checks.criteria: Description of quality assurance process and recall procedures. 核對數值、單位、分母、期間、所有要求細分及所需行動／監察；索引不算實際披露。零值與明確否定陳述可以是有效披露；條文中的where appropriate／if applicable不可刪掉。

checks.rule_quote:

checks.criteria: Focus areas of contribution (e.g. education, environmental concerns, labour needs, health, culture, sport). 核對數值、單位、分母、期間、所有要求細分及所需行動／監察；索引不算實際披露。零值與明確否定陳述可以是有效披露；條文中的where appropriate／if applicable不可刪掉。

checks.label: 投入社區的金錢或時間
checks.rule_quote: Resources contributed (e.g. money or time) to the focus area.
checks.criteria: Resources contributed (e.g. money or time) to the focus area. 核對數值、單位、分母、期間、所有要求細分及所需行動／監察；索引不算實際披露。零值與明確否定陳述可以是有效披露；條文中的where appropriate／if applicable不可刪掉。

checks.label: 尚未披露項目的工作計劃
checks.rule_quote: work plan, progress and timetable
checks.criteria: 此項屬鼓勵披露；有不披露或寬免主張時記錄補充披露的工作計劃、進度及時間表。

checks.label: 氣候監督機構或負責人
checks.rule_quote: the governance body(s)
checks.criteria: 董事會／委員會或負責人的身份及監督職責；可與B13合併披露，不要求重複章節。

checks.label: 氣候監督的技能及能力
checks.rule_quote: how the body(s) or individual(s) determines whether appropriate skills
checks.criteria: 現有或將發展的技能能力，以及如何作此判斷。

checks.label: 氣候資訊匯報方式及頻率
checks.rule_quote: how and how often the body(s) or individual(s) is informed
checks.criteria: 方式及頻率均須核對。

checks.label: 氣候事項納入策略及重大交易
checks.rule_quote: when overseeing the issuer’s strategy, its decisions on major transactions
checks.criteria: 策略、重大交易、風險管理及相關政策如何考慮風險機遇及權衡。

checks.label: 監督氣候目標及薪酬連結
checks.rule_quote: oversees the setting of, and monitors progress
checks.criteria: 目標訂立、進度監督及是否／如何連結薪酬；可交叉引用35。

checks.label: 管理層氣候職責及監督
checks.rule_quote: whether the role is delegated to a specific management-level position
checks.criteria: 職責委派對象及其監督安排。

checks.label: 管理層控制程序及內部整合
checks.rule_quote: whether management uses controls and procedures
checks.criteria: 有否及如何使用控制程序，與其他內部職能如何整合。

checks.label: 氣候風險機遇及財務影響
checks.rule_quote: describe climate-related risks and opportunities
checks.criteria: 對現金流、融資或資本成本可能有影響的風險及機遇。

checks.label: 實體及轉型風險分類
checks.rule_quote: physical risk or climate-related transition risk
checks.criteria: 逐項風險的實體／轉型分類。

checks.label: 風險機遇的時間跨度
checks.rule_quote: over which time horizons
checks.criteria: 各項風險及機遇的短中長期影響。

checks.label: 短中長期定義及規劃銜接
checks.rule_quote: how the issuer defines ‘short term’
checks.criteria: 三種期限的定義與策略規劃時間的關係。

checks.label: 商業敏感機遇的豁免主張
checks.rule_quote: disclose the fact that it has used the exemption
checks.criteria: 只限機遇、非公開、嚴重損害經濟利益且不能用彙總披露達標；使用時披露事實及每期重評。不得把一般保密理由當已批准豁免。

checks.label: 業務模式及價值鏈影響
checks.rule_quote: current and anticipated effects
checks.criteria: 需有目前及預期影響，不能只列一般氣候風險名稱。

checks.label: 風險機遇集中位置
checks.rule_quote: where in the issuer’s business model and value chain
checks.criteria: 地區、設施、資產類型等集中位置。

checks.label: 業務模式及資源調整
checks.rule_quote: current and anticipated changes to the issuer’s business model
checks.criteria: 目前及預期變更，包括資源分配。

checks.label: 適應及減緩措施
checks.rule_quote: current and anticipated adaptation and mitigation efforts
checks.criteria: 目前與預期、直接或間接措施。

checks.label: 氣候轉型計劃或否定陳述
checks.rule_quote: or an appropriate negative statement where the issuer does not have
checks.criteria: 有計劃則披露主要假設及依賴條件；沒有可明確作否定陳述。

checks.label: 實現氣候目標的方法
checks.rule_quote: how the issuer plans to achieve any climate-related targets
checks.criteria: 與37–40所列目標相對應的實現方法。

checks.label: 氣候行動的資源投入
checks.rule_quote: how the issuer is resourcing, and plans to resource
checks.criteria: 現有及計劃資源如何支持22(a)活動。

checks.label: 以往氣候計劃的進度
checks.rule_quote: progress of plans disclosed in previous reporting periods
checks.criteria: 本稿是否披露以往計劃的進度；未提供舊報告時不能確認已完整承接所有舊承諾。

checks.label: 本期氣候財務影響
checks.rule_quote: financial position, financial performance and cash flows for the reporting period
checks.criteria: 定性及定量、本期財務狀況、業績及現金流；量化豁免須按25附註3/5核對，不直接判漏。

checks.label: 下年度重大賬面值調整風險
checks.rule_quote: a material adjustment within the next annual reporting period
checks.criteria: 資產及負債的賬面值重大調整風險；明確無此風險可作有效陳述。

checks.label: 財務影響與財報項目銜接
checks.rule_quote: explain how such information is reflected in its financial statements
checks.criteria: 量化資訊如非財報獨立行，需說明反映在哪些財務項目。

checks.label: 預期財務狀況、投資及資金
checks.rule_quote: its investment and disposal plans
checks.criteria: 短中長期財務狀況變化、投資／處置計劃及資金來源；核對25附註的量化寬免條件。

checks.label: 預期業績及現金流影響
checks.rule_quote: financial performance and cash flows to change
checks.criteria: 短中長期業績及現金流的定性及定量資訊，適用量化寬免須有依據。

checks.label: 財務量化寬免的原因及替代披露
checks.rule_quote: explain why it has not provided quantitative information
checks.criteria: 核對不能分開辨識／高度不確定性；欠技能能力資源只適用預期量化。主張寬免時需原因、定性影響及相關財報項目；附註5(c)合併量化或無用處判斷亦須核對（PDF20）。

checks.label: 氣候韌性評估結果

checks.criteria: 評估日期、策略及業務模式意涵、重大不確定性及短中長期適應能力。

checks.label: 情境分析輸入的七項資料

checks.criteria: 情境及來源、多樣性、實體／轉型、最新國際協議相容情境及選擇原因、時間及營運範圍；完整要求延續至PDF21。

checks.label: 情境分析主要假設

checks.criteria: 核對主要假設；不能用模型常識補充。

checks.label: 情境分析執行期間

checks.label: 風險程序的輸入及參數

checks.criteria: 資料來源及程序涵蓋營運範圍。

checks.label: 情境分析納入風險辨識
checks.rule_quote: whether and how the issuer uses climate-related scenario analysis
checks.criteria: 是否及如何使用；否定陳述不等於自動違規。

checks.label: 風險性質、機率及影響程度
checks.rule_quote: nature, likelihood and magnitude
checks.criteria: 定性因素、量化門檻或其他評估準則。

checks.label: 氣候風險與其他風險排序
checks.rule_quote: prioritises climate-related risks relative to other types of risks
checks.criteria: 是否及如何相對其他風險排序。

checks.label: 氣候風險監察
checks.rule_quote: how the issuer monitors climate-related risks
checks.criteria: 實際監察程序。

checks.label: 風險程序的跨年變更
checks.rule_quote: changed the processes it uses compared with the previous reporting period
checks.criteria: 是否及如何改變；明確無變更可有效披露。

checks.label: 氣候機遇管理程序
checks.rule_quote: the processes the issuer uses to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor
checks.criteria: 機遇辨識、評估、排序、監察及是否／如何使用情境分析。

checks.label: 整體風險管理整合
checks.rule_quote: integrated into and inform the issuer’s overall risk management process
checks.criteria: 整合程度及方法，可引用綜合ESG風險管理，毋須重複章節。

checks.label: Scope 1 排放總量、單位及期間
checks.rule_quote: Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions
checks.criteria: 當期absolute gross總量、metric tonnes CO2e及清楚期間；不可用淨抵銷值代替，不能從表格總數推定gross方法。

checks.label: Scope 2 排放總量、單位及期間
checks.rule_quote: Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions
checks.criteria: 當期absolute gross總量、metric tonnes CO2e及清楚期間；不可用淨抵銷值代替，不能從表格總數推定gross方法。

checks.label: Scope 3 排放總量、單位及期間
checks.rule_quote: Scope 3 greenhouse gas emissions
checks.criteria: 當期absolute gross總量、metric tonnes CO2e及清楚期間；不可用淨抵銷值代替，不能從表格總數推定gross方法。

checks.label: 溫室氣體計量標準
checks.rule_quote: Greenhouse Gas Protocol: A Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (2004)
checks.criteria: 核對各適用Scope，非僅Scope3；其他計量標準須有管轄機關或另一上市交易所要求依據。

checks.label: 排放方法、輸入及假設
checks.rule_quote: the measurement approach, inputs and assumptions
checks.criteria: 方法、輸入及假設各自核對；需跨讀能源表及腳註；因子來源並不代表完整方法。

checks.label: 選擇排放計量方法的原因
checks.rule_quote: the reason why the issuer has chosen
checks.criteria: 方法、輸入及假設的選擇原因；與本期變更原因不同。

checks.label: 排放方法變更及原因
checks.rule_quote: any changes the issuer made to the measurement approach
checks.criteria: 本期方法、輸入、假設的變更及原因。

checks.label: Scope 2 地點基準排放
checks.rule_quote: disclose its location-based Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions
checks.criteria: location-based須清晰；地區因子只能部分支持，market-based不能取代。

checks.label: Scope 2 合約文書資訊
checks.rule_quote: provide information about any contractual instruments
checks.criteria: 如有相關文書，需足以理解Scope2的資訊；未提及不能推定沒有。

checks.label: Scope 3 涵蓋類別
checks.rule_quote: disclose the categories included within the issuer’s measure
checks.criteria: 依2011價值鏈標準說明納入的類別；本項不表示所有15類均適用，核對界定及理由。

checks.label: 價值鏈數據期間差異
checks.rule_quote: the length of the reporting periods is the same
checks.criteria: 如採不同期間的價值鏈數據，核對最近可取得、期間長度相同及期間之間重大事件影響披露。

checks.label: 金融業融資排放補充
checks.rule_quote: additional information about the issuer’s Category 15
checks.criteria: 只在業務包括資產管理、商業銀行或保險時考慮；屬鼓勵披露。

checks.label: 轉型風險資產／業務金額及比例
checks.rule_quote: assets or business activities vulnerable to climate-related transition risks
checks.criteria: 金額及百分比、對應資產／業務及分母；估計毛利損失不自動等同受影響業務比例。

checks.label: 實體風險資產／業務金額及比例
checks.rule_quote: assets or business activities vulnerable to climate-related physical risks
checks.criteria: 金額及百分比，以及資產／業務範圍和分母。

checks.label: 氣候機遇資產／業務金額及比例
checks.rule_quote: assets or business activities aligned with climate-related opportunities
checks.criteria: 金額及百分比，以及資產／業務範圍和分母。

checks.label: 氣候資本、融資及投資金額
checks.rule_quote: capital expenditure, financing or investment
checks.criteria: 投向氣候風險及機遇的資本開支、融資或投資金額。

checks.label: 內部碳價或否定陳述
checks.rule_quote: does not apply a carbon price in decision-making
checks.criteria: 有使用時需是否及如何用於決策及每噸價格；沒有可明確否定，不能要求虛構碳價。

checks.label: 氣候薪酬連結或否定陳述
checks.rule_quote: whether and how climate-related considerations are factored
checks.criteria: 是否及如何納入薪酬，或明確否定；可與19(a)(iv)合併。

checks.label: 行業指標
checks.rule_quote: An issuer is encouraged to disclose industry-based metrics
checks.criteria: 建議披露；參考相關行業指標及適用性，不把未披露當硬性缺失。

checks.label: 自訂及法定氣候目標
checks.rule_quote: qualitative and quantitative climate-related targets
checks.criteria: 自訂及法規要求目標；不能假設一定有某個未證實法定目標。

checks.label: 目標指標
checks.rule_quote: the metric used to set the target
checks.criteria: 逐個目標對應指標。

checks.label: 目標目的
checks.rule_quote: the objective of the target
checks.criteria: 減緩、適應或科學倡議等目的。

checks.label: 目標涵蓋範圍
checks.rule_quote: the part of the issuer to which the target applies
checks.criteria: 全公司或指定業務、地區等。

checks.label: 目標期間
checks.rule_quote: the period over which the target applies
checks.criteria: 每項目標適用期間。

checks.label: 目標基準期
checks.rule_quote: the base period from which progress is measured
checks.criteria: 每項目標基準期。

checks.label: 里程碑或中期目標
checks.rule_quote: milestones or interim targets (if any)
checks.criteria: 如有才要求；不能將沒有中期目標自動判硬性遺漏。

checks.label: 絕對值或密度目標
checks.rule_quote: whether the target is an absolute target or an intensity target
checks.criteria: 量化目標需說明絕對或強度；定性目標不適用此細項。

checks.label: 國際協議及地區承諾如何影響目標
checks.rule_quote: how the latest international agreement on climate change
checks.criteria: 如何影響目標設定，包括相關地區承諾；不替公司補充主張。

checks.label: 目標及方法是否第三方驗證
checks.rule_quote: whether the target and the methodology for setting the target has been validated
checks.criteria: 是否驗證及對應目標；並非強制必須找第三方驗證。

checks.label: 目標檢討程序
checks.rule_quote: the issuer’s processes for reviewing the target
checks.criteria: 逐項目標的檢討程序。

checks.label: 監察目標進度的指標
checks.rule_quote: the metrics used to monitor progress
checks.criteria: 逐項目標的進度指標。

checks.label: 目標修訂及原因
checks.rule_quote: any revisions to the target and an explanation
checks.criteria: 如有修訂，需內容及原因。

checks.label: 氣候目標表現及趨勢
checks.rule_quote: performance against each climate-related target
checks.criteria: 對每項目標的表現及趨勢／變動分析；僅年度同比不必然等同對目標基準期進度。

checks.label: 排放目標涵蓋氣體
checks.rule_quote: which greenhouse gases are covered by the target
checks.criteria: 每項排放目標涵蓋哪些氣體。

checks.label: 排放目標涵蓋 Scope
checks.rule_quote: whether Scope 1, Scope 2 or Scope 3
checks.criteria: 每項目標所涵蓋範圍。

checks.label: 總量及淨排放目標
checks.rule_quote: separately disclose its associated gross greenhouse gas emissions target
checks.criteria: 標明gross/net；淨目標另需gross目標。

checks.label: 行業減碳路徑
checks.rule_quote: whether the target was derived using a sectoral decarbonisation approach
checks.criteria: 是否使用行業減碳方法，否定陳述可有效。

checks.label: 碳信用依賴程度
checks.rule_quote: relies on the use of carbon credits
checks.criteria: 若計劃以碳信用達成淨排放目標，披露程度及方法。

checks.label: 碳信用第三方認證計劃
checks.rule_quote: which third-party scheme(s) will verify or certify
checks.criteria: 計劃使用碳信用時的認證計劃。

checks.label: 碳信用類型及減碳／移除
checks.rule_quote: the type of carbon credit
checks.criteria: 自然／技術移除及減排／移除的類型。

checks.label: 碳信用可信度及完整性
checks.rule_quote: credibility and integrity of the carbon credits
checks.criteria: 理解可信度及完整性所需其他因素，例如永久性假設。

checks.label: 跨行業及行業指標的適用性考慮
checks.rule_quote: refer to and consider the applicability
checks.criteria: 準備21–26及37–38時考慮跨行業及行業指標；第36仍屬鼓勵披露，不能因本條把全部行業指標轉為強制。

scope_note: C2第1–41段及Part C現行一般披露／KPI全數登記；披露項、程序及建議項分開，並非全部屬硬性義務。外部引用準則、台帳及法律合規真實性不由PDF單獨證實。
